system.description:
Make an Interface Roll (16). Once per
long rest on a success, plunge the
entire area within Far range into
complete darkness, signal blackout,
smoke saturation, sensor denial, or
light-eating interference that only you
and your allies can see through.
Attack rolls have disadvantage when
targeting you or an ally within this
blackout.
Additionally, when you or an ally
succeeds with Hope against an
adversary within this blackout, the
target must mark a Stress.
This protocol lasts until the GM spends
a Fear on their turn to clear this effect
or you take Severe damage.
